race.comment: MAJESTIC FURY (6) has won both trials this time and looks ready to go. Not a lot of depth here and draws to advantage, which should have her in the firing line. SHAMUS IN PONTIVY (7) looks clearly the pick of the raced brigade, finding the line nicely last start to get up for second over 1350m at Strathalbyn. Experience could prove crucial here. UPINTHECITY (8) was out of the money when resuming two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1100m at Wodonga, beaten just under a length. Hard to beat in this suitable race. LITTLE GANGSTER (10) will find this much more suitable than the debut run in town and has been trialling adequately.
